shapeSummary: Cylindrical gear motor with its axis along Z and its bottom at Y=0. It has a 36 mm encoder cap (z -90 to -75), a 36 mm motor can (z -75 to -30), and a 37 mm gearbox (z -30 to 10). An 8 mm round output shaft runs from z=10 to z=90 (80 mm).
warnings: Body diameter, body length and the split between encoder, motor and gearbox sections are estimated, because the drawing gives no dimensions.
The 80 mm figure is taken as the shaft length. The roughly 100 mm body length is an assumption.
The REX shaft is modeled as a plain 8 mm cylinder with no hex profile.
Omitted for lack of dimensions: the gearbox pilot boss, mounting screw holes on the gearbox face, the shaft-end tapped hole, the encoder wires and connectors, and the yellow jacket detail.
cadquery:
yc = 18.5

def cyl(z0, h, d):
    return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0, yc).circle(d / 2).extrude(h)

# rear encoder cap, motor can, gearbox (axis along Z, centered on the 180 mm overall length)
encoder = cyl(-90, 15, 36)
motor = cyl(-75, 45, 36)
gearbox = cyl(-30, 40, 37)
# 8 mm output shaft, 80 mm long from the gearbox face at z=10 to the tip at z=90
shaft = cyl(10, 80, 8)

part = encoder.union(motor).union(gearbox).union(shaft)
